audio.text: Why is the science building locked this afternoon?

options: Yes, I locked my bike to the metal railing right outside the door.
It's the tall one next to the library.
They're replacing some of the building's windows, I heard.

why.en: "Why" → a reason. A answers with "Yes" and repeats "locked"; B gives a time; C says where the building is.
why.tr: "Why" → sebep. A "Yes" diyor ve "locked" kelimesini tekrar ediyor; B zaman veriyor; C binanın nerede olduğunu söylüyor.
why.es: "Why" → un motivo. A responde "Yes" y repite "locked"; B da una hora; C dice dónde está el edificio.
